dictionary.在之前的战役中我们处于劣势，甚至我们的士兵都害怕听到敌军统帅的名字。: We were in disadvantage positions in previous campaigns, even our soldiers are afraid to hear the enemy commander 's name.
dictionary.我们所有的军队都投入到这场战争中，如果我们失败后果将非常严重。: All our troops are put into this war. If we fail, the consequences will be devastating.
dictionary.我命令所有的预备队都投入到战斗中，同时我本人也会和国家共存亡！: I am ordering all the reserves to join the battle, and I myself will live or perish with our country!
dictionary.士兵们，我们是狮子，敌人是绵羊。现在捕猎的时间到了。: Soldiers, we are lions, the enemies are sheep. Now it's time to hunt.
dictionary.让所有的敌人在我们的炮火中消失，我要让他们听到我的名字就发抖。: Let all the enemies perish under our firepower. They will shudder when the hear my name.
dictionary.各位将军,你们了解我的实力，请把这场战争最精彩的部分留给我。: Generals, you know my strength, please leave the most exciting part of this war to me.
dictionary.我根本不需要援军，我的军队可以轻松对付前方的敌军。: I don't need reinforcements. I can deal with the enemy in the front with ease.
dictionary.这些敌军简直不堪一击，我已经很久没有遇到真正的对手了。: The enemy is simply vulnerable. I haven't encountered an equal for a long time.
dictionary.应该告诉我们的敌人，如果现在放下武器从战场上离开还来得及!: Our enemies should be told that it's still not too late if they lay down weapons and leave the battlefield now!
dictionary.我们突进的速度实在是太快了，敌人根本没有意识到我们已经到了他们的后方。: Our onrush is too fast. the enemy hasn't realized at all until we are already in their rear.
dictionary.在战场上永远都会有机会！如果没有，那就去创造机会。: There's always a chance on the battlefield! If not, create one.
dictionary.不要小看我们这次的对手，他们都是经验丰富的战士。: Do not underestimate our opponents this time. They are experienced fighters.
dictionary.我的军队会像利剑一样劈开敌人的防线。: My troop will split the enemy lines like a sharp sword.
dictionary.看来我们离战场已经非常近了，我已经隐约可以听到炮声。: It seems we're very close to battlefield. I can vaguely hear gunfire.
dictionary.我们的计划已经成功了，全军进攻！: Our plan has been successful. All-out attack!
dictionary.因为有了你们的援助，相信这次我会很快获得胜利。: I believe we will secure a quick victory because of your assistance.
dictionary.敌军应该已经能听到我们整齐的脚步声和有节奏的鼓声。: The enemy should be able to hear our orderly footsteps and rhythmic drums.
dictionary.我的军队已经摆好了阵型，密集的火力会让敌军根本无法接近我们。: The formation of my army is ready. Intensive fires will simply drive away any enemy who attempts to draw close.
dictionary.快点排好阵型准备射击，敌人的骑兵马上就要冲过来了。: Form formation quickly and prepare to shoot, the enemy cavalry is about to charge towards us.
dictionary.所有士兵在射击完后将你们的刺刀都装配上，准备冲锋。: All soldiers, put on your bayonets after shooting, prepare to charge.
dictionary.我们遭到骑兵猛烈的攻击，必须迅速转变阵型。: We've encountered violent attack of cavalry and must change formation immediately.
dictionary.敌军前方的要塞是我们前进最大的障碍，必须将它彻底攻陷。: The enemy fortress in the front is the biggest obstacle on our route. We must destroy it completely.
dictionary.如果使用围城炮，我们攻克敌军要塞的把握会大很多。: If you use the Siege Artillery, this will greatly enhance the chances of capturing enemy fortresses.
dictionary.在兵力不多的情况下，我们必须绕过前方的要塞才可以到达指定地点。: We must bypass fortresses in front to reach the designated location under the situation of insufficient troop number.
dictionary.我命令所有的舰船不要轻易靠近敌军的海岸炮。: I am ordering that all ships must not get close to coastal fort of the enemy.
dictionary.前面的要塞非常的坚固，选择进攻这里显然并不明智。: The fortress in the front is very strong. It's clearly not a wise choice to attack it.
dictionary.敌军的主力已经向我的要塞靠近，我会让他们知道我的要塞有多么坚固。: The main force of the enemy is drawing closer to my fortress. I will let them know how strong my fortress is.
dictionary.敌人的要塞太坚固了，我需要火炮支援。: The enemy's fortress is too strong. I need artillery support.
dictionary.敌军已经快要攻陷我的要塞了！: The enemy has almost captured my fortress!
dictionary.敌军的海岸炮太多了，我的舰队无法靠近岸边。: There're too many coastal fortresses of the enemy. My fleet cannot get close to the shore.
dictionary.敌军舰队的火力非常猛烈，一定要想个办法避开他们。: The firepower of the enemy fleet is very strong. We must find a way to bypass them.
dictionary.敌军舰队已经出现，全速前进！集中一切火力将敌军的战舰击沉。: The enemy's fleet has emerged. Full speed forward! Concentrate all firepower to sink the enemy battleships.
dictionary.我的舰队可以轻松的击败敌人!我希望你们能赶上我的步伐。: My fleet can easily destroy the enemy! I hope you can catch up with my pace.
dictionary.我会帮助你对付敌人的战舰，保证你的部队尽快登陆。: I will help you deal with the enemy battleships to ensure the earliest landing of your troop.
dictionary.我的舰队受损严重，没想到敌军的战舰火力竟然如此凶猛。: My fleet is badly damaged. I didn't expect that the enemy battleships' fire could be so fierce.
dictionary.你们现在防守的港口地理位置非常重要。请一定要守住!: The location of the port you're defending is very important. Please secure it at all cost!
dictionary.我的舰队将全力给你提供掩护，你们一定要以最快的速度登陆。: My fleet will give you full cover. You must land as fast as possible.
dictionary.我所有的火炮都已经准备就绪，只等你开火的命令。: All my artilleries are ready, just waiting for your order.
dictionary.敌军守城的部队仍然不肯撤退，让我用火炮瓦解他们的最后的意志。: The enemy troops guarding the city still refuse to retreat. Let me destroy their last will with artillery.
dictionary.当我的火炮开始攻击时，请你们的骑兵和步兵作好冲锋的准备。: When I start the artillery attack, please let your cavalry and infantry prepare to charge.
dictionary.请保护好我的炮兵，我们无法经受敌军骑兵的攻击。: Please protect my artillery troop. We cannot withstand the enemy cavalry's attack.
dictionary.集中使用炮兵是我经常获胜的原因之一，要让敌军畏惧我们的炮火。: Concentrated artillery attack is one of factors in my victory formula. Let the enemy fear our firepower.
dictionary.当敌军进入了我们的射程就猛烈的攻击，千万别让他们靠近。: Launch violent attack when the enemy enters our range. Do not let them get close.
dictionary.我们的火炮将不间断的向这座城市发射炮弹，直到他们投降为止。: Our artillery will fire ceaselessly to the city until they surrender.
dictionary.我的炮兵部队会给你们强大的火力支援！: My artillery troop will give you a strong fire support!
dictionary.我们的骑兵须要尽量绕开山脉和树林，否则很难发挥出应有的速度优势。: Our cavalry need to bypass the mountains and woods, or it'll be difficult to show our speed advantage.
dictionary.从侧翼突袭敌军，我们的出现会让敌军大吃一惊！: Assault the enemy from the flanks. Our appearance will surprise the enemy!
dictionary.我的骑兵只用了几天就突破了敌军的防线，我们的速度已经超出了他们的想象。: My cavalry has broken through the enemy's defense line within just few days. Our speed has exceeded their expectations.
dictionary.敌人应该能够听到我骑兵的马蹄声吧，难道他们还不感到恐惧么？: The enemy should be able to hear my cavalry hoofs. Don't they fear it?
dictionary.敌军的步兵和炮兵都不在平原上，这样的地形让我的骑兵很难发挥出优势。: The enemy infantry and artillery are not in the plain, so it's difficult for my cavalry to play the advantages on such terrain.
dictionary.敌军后方的城市防御十分薄弱，我的骑兵会快速将这些据点占领。: City defense of the enemy's rear is quite weak. My cavalry will quickly capture these strongholds.
dictionary.敌军根本无法阻挡我的骑兵的突袭。: the enemy simply cannot stop my cavalry raids.
dictionary.大家都记住！炮兵最怕我们骑兵，遇到敌军炮兵就要不停的进攻。: All remember! Artillery fears our cavalry the most. Attack continuously when we encounter the enemy artillery troop.
dictionary.我们的部队损失惨重。我现在需要你们的援助！: Our troop has suffered heavy losses. I need your support!
dictionary.我们已经被敌军包围，如果没有援助，被消灭只是时间问题。: We've been surrounded by the enemy. It's just a matter of time before our annihilation without reinforcement.
dictionary.敌人的部队已经攻破了我们的防线，预备队现在在哪里？: The enemy troop has broken through our defense. Where is the reserve?
dictionary.我的后方怎么会出现敌军？这绝对是个最坏的消息。: How did the enemy appear behind me? This is definitely the worst news.
dictionary.如果能得到你们的援助，我就可以快速的结束这场战争。: If we get your assistance, I can end this war quickly.
dictionary.将军们，你们的部队在那里？我需要你们保护我的后方。: Generals, where are your troops? I need you to cover my rear.
dictionary.敌人已经切断了我们的退路，我现在能做的就是等待援军的到来。: The enemy has cut off our retreat route. The only thing I can do now is to wait for the arrival of reinforcements.
dictionary.我将负责这里的防守。各位将军，如果可以请尽早过来援助我。: I will be responsible for the defense here. Generals, please reinforce me as soon as possible.
dictionary.敌军的主力已经开始向我的阵地发起猛攻，我需要援助。: The main force of the enemy has initiated onslaught to my position. I need assistance.
dictionary.我们的粮食已经不多，我不希望我的士兵都饿着肚子作战。: There's not much food left. I don't want my soldiers fighting with empty stomachs.
dictionary.我们的部队携带的食物有限，必须尽快的结束这场战斗。: Provisions we could carry is limited. We must end this battle as soon as possible.
dictionary.你们答应运送给我的食物为什么到现在还没送到？: Why the food you promised to deliver hasn't arrived yet?
dictionary.敌人的农场将会为我们提供足够的食物！士兵们，去占领他们的农场。: The enemy farm will provide enough food for us! Soldiers, capture their farms.
dictionary.快点占领敌军的农场，不要给敌军留下一粒粮食。: Capture the enemy farms quickly. Do not leave a grain to the enemy.
dictionary.我们已经被敌军包围，可能过不了多久就会被消灭。: We have been surrounded by the enemy. It may not be long before we're destroyed.
dictionary.敌人的攻势太过于猛烈，我们基本上没有获胜的可能。: The enemy's attack is too violent. We basically do not stand a chance of winning.
dictionary.在这个关键的时刻，撤退就等于放弃以前所有的努力。: At this critical moment, retreat means giving up all the previous efforts.
dictionary.敌人的军队数量超出了我们好几倍，我想我们可能无法取得胜利了。: The enemy troops outnumber ours several times. I think we might not be able to win.
dictionary.将军们，面对现实吧。我们已经输掉了这场战争。: Generals, face the fact. We have already lost the war.
dictionary.军队已经开始溃散，看来我们要做好撤退的准备了。: The army is starting to collapse. It seems that we need to prepare for retreat.
dictionary.目前的状况已经不可能让我们再发动进攻了。: The current situation doesn't allow us to launch further attacks.
dictionary.敌人的防线太坚固了，以我们现有的兵力很难从正面突破。: The enemy's defense is too solid to break from the front with our existing force.
dictionary.糟糕的天气已经让我的军队失去了战斗力！: The bad weather has made my army lose combat ability!
dictionary.我们的盟友已经被敌人消灭了，目前我们只能依靠我们自己。: Our allies have been destroyed by the enemy, now we can only rely on ourselves.
dictionary.我的军队面临被敌人包围的危险，现在该怎么做？: My army is in danger of being surrounded by the enemy. What can we do now?
dictionary.将军们，这样下去我们可能会全军覆没。: Generals, we might be annihilated under current situation.
dictionary.士兵们都在议论，这里的抵抗是否已经失去了意义？: The soldiers are talking about whether the resistance here is worthy.
dictionary.这是一场毫无意义的战争，为什么一定要我要参加这场战争？: This war is meaningless. Why must I participate in this war?
dictionary.请坚持住！我的军队会尽快赶到战场。: Hang in there! My troop will arrive in battlefield soon.
dictionary.集结部队需要一定的时间，请再坚持一会儿。: The troop assemblage takes some time. Please hold a while more.
dictionary.根据计划我将会保护您的侧翼不受到攻击，你们可以放心的进攻。: According to the plan, I will protect your flanks. You can feel free to attack.
dictionary.我需要你们的配合才能夺取敌军的城市。请给我最大的支持。: I need your cooperation to capture the enemy cities. Please give me the best support.
dictionary.我会尽量坚持到援军的到来，也请你的军队加快进军的速度！: I will try to hold until the arrival of reinforcements. Please speed up!
dictionary.如果时间允许，我的军队将会配合你从敌军的后方发起进攻。: If time permits, I will attack the enemy from the rear in coordination.
dictionary.加速前进！不能让敌人击溃我们的盟友。: Speed up! We cannot allow the enemy to defeat our allies.
dictionary.由于敌人的援军大量的加入战场，我的军队目前损失很大。: Due to a large number of enemy reinforcements in the battlefield, my army has suffered great losses up to now.
dictionary.我的军队在和敌军的作战中损失很大，可能无法再帮助你了。: My troop has suffered great losses in combat, so we may not be able to help you anymore.
dictionary.盟友并没有延缓敌军前进的速度，看来我高估他们的实力了。: Allies did not slow down the speed of enemy. It seems that I overestimated their strength.
dictionary.为了能尽快取得胜利，我需要你在海面上配合我的行动。: I need you to cooperate my actions on the sea in order to secure victory as soon as possible.
dictionary.你的军队作战实在是太勇猛了，你是怎么做到的？: Your army fights so bravely. How did you manage that?
dictionary.太精彩了！我亲眼看到了你运用高超的战术击退敌军。: Excellent! I saw the superb tactics you adopted to repel the enemy.
dictionary.你是我见过最优秀的将领，如果我们合作能取得更多的战绩。: You're the best general I've ever seen. If we cooperate, we can achieve more records.
dictionary.居然能够那么快击败敌军，你简直是一个战争天才。: Defeat enemy in such a short time. You're a genius of war.
dictionary.你的知名度非常高，我为能和你并肩作战而感到骄傲。: It's my honor to be able to fight alongside such a famous person like you.
dictionary.我无法想象这一切是真的，我们真的击败了敌军！: I cannot imagine that all is true. We have really defeated the enemy!
dictionary.我已经被任命为军队的总指挥，我将全权负责这次战役。: I have been appointed as the chief commander. I will be responsible for the campaign completely.
dictionary.我是一名职业军人，我忠于我的国家和人民。: I'm a professional soldier. I'm loyal to my country and people.
dictionary.我已经处决了几个企图逃跑的士兵，不用怀疑我对国家的忠诚！: I have executed several soldiers who attempted to flee. There is no need to doubt my loyalty to the country!
dictionary.你们并没有按照计划向敌军发起攻击，我有理由怀疑你们对国家的忠诚！: You did not attack the enemy according to the plan. I have reason to suspect your loyalty to the country!
dictionary.各位将军们，我希望我们能在敌军的首都会师。: Generals, I hope we can join forces in the capital of the enemy.
dictionary.我们已经占领了敌人的首都，胜利只是时间问题。: We have already captured the enemy 's capital. The victory is only a matter of time.
dictionary.进攻敌军首都的命令已经交给了我，这将是我们军事生涯最辉煌的时刻。: I've received the command of attacking the enemy 's capital. This will be our most brilliant moment in our military careers.
dictionary.无论如何也不能放弃我们的首都，我想你应该明白这一点。: In any case we cannot give up our capital. I think you all understand.
dictionary.看到敌军首都了吧？我们只要攻占这里，战争就结束了。: See the enemy's capital? Once we capture it, the war is over.
dictionary.首都沦陷的消息让我们都非常沮丧！: We are all very frustrated at the news of the falling of our capital!
dictionary.虽然我们已经占领了敌军的首都，但敌军残留的部队依然对我们存在威胁。: Although we have occupied the capital of the enemy, but the enemy's remnants are still threats to us.
dictionary.我已经做好了充分的准备，就等着敌军过来！: I have made full preparation, only waiting for the arrival of the enemy!
dictionary.我们已经构筑了坚固的防线来等待敌军。: We have built a solid defense line to greet the enemy.
dictionary.现在的局势下，主动进攻显然不太实际。我们能做的就是防守。: Under current situation, proactive attacks are obviously not feasible. The only thing we can do is to defend.
dictionary.你们可以放心的把防御的任务交给我，敌军无法踏进我们的国土。: You can leave defense task to me, the enemy won't be able to step into our land.
dictionary.全军收缩防线，等待援军的到来！坚持住！: All drop deeper and wait for the arrival of reinforcements! Hold on!
dictionary.我的军队将尽全力来保卫这座城市，一定不让它落入敌军的手中。: My army will put out every bit of effort to defend the city. We won't allow it to fall into the enemy's hands.
dictionary.为了阻止我们继续推进，敌军在我们面前修建了规模巨大的防御工事。: The enemy has built huge fortifications in front of us to prevent our advancement.
dictionary.为什么我的侧面会突然出现敌军？我命令全军转入防守状态。: Why did the enemy suddenly appear on my flank? I am ordering the whole army change to defensive state.
dictionary.我们需要渡过前面的河流，向对岸的敌军发起全面进攻。: We need get across the river ahead to launch an all-out attack on the enemy on the other side.
dictionary.占领前方的桥梁，否则渡河会耗费我们不少时间。: Capture the bridge in the front, otherwise it would take a lot of time to cross the river.
dictionary.敌军的炮兵部署在了河流对面，这对我们很不利。: The enemy has deployed artilleries on the opposite side of the river. It is very unfavorable to us.
dictionary.一旦让敌军渡过前面的河，他们就会威胁到我们很多城市的安全。: Once the enemy crosses the river in the front, they will threaten the safety of many of our cities.
dictionary.如果敌军进入树林，我们的火炮就不太容易击中他们。: If the enemy enters the woods, it will be hard for our artillery to hit them.
dictionary.前方出现了大片树林，我的骑兵速度优势将很难发挥。: There are large woods ahead. My cavalry will have difficulty to utilise the speed advantage.
dictionary.我们会从几个方向同时向敌军边境发起攻击，我们的优势很明显。: We will launch strikes to the enemy's border from several directions simultaneously. We have obvious advantages.
dictionary.我的军团已经将敌军分割包围，歼灭敌军只是时间问题。: My regiment has split and surrounded the enemy troops. It's just a matter of time to annihilate them.
dictionary.这里是我们最后的防线，你们应该知道这里的重要性。: Here is our last defense line. You should know the importance of this position.
dictionary.我们必须在这里阻挡敌军的进攻，任何形式的撤退都将视为叛国。: We must stop the enemy's attack here. Retreat under any situation will be considered treason.
dictionary.敌人前线的军队很强大，但是后方的防御力量比较薄弱。你应该明白我的意思！: The enemy troops at the front are very powerful, but the defense at the rear is relatively weak. You should see what I mean!
dictionary.起义军已经答应配合我们，现在是我们进军的好时机！: The rebels have promised to cooperate with us. It's a good chance to advance now!
dictionary.我们不能太乐观，冬季的寒冷会严重影响我军的战斗力。: We cannot be too optimistic. Cold winter will seriously affect our army's battle effectiveness.
dictionary.为了这次战争我们已经准备了一年多。这将是一场规模巨大的登陆作战。: We have already prepared more than a year for this war. It would be a huge-scale landing operation.
dictionary.敌军的补给出现了严重的问题。发起反攻的时刻到了！: The enemy has encountered serious supply problems. It's time to launch counter-attacks!
dictionary.在没有做好准备前贸然对敌军进攻是相当危险的。: It's quite dangerous to attack the enemy without good preparation.
dictionary.我渴望和敌军决战，为什么还不下命令，这一刻我已经等了很久了！: I'm eager to fight the enemy. Why hasn't the command come? I have been waiting for this moment for a long time!
dictionary.我们需要夺取前方的城市，为下一步进攻做好准备。: We need to capture the city ahead to prepare for the next attack.
dictionary.这是我们遇到的最大的危机，我们不得不面对数倍于我们的敌人。: This is the biggest crisis we've met. We have to face the enemy which far outnumbers us.
dictionary.登陆部队不要和敌军的战舰纠缠，你们只需要快速登陆就够了。: Landing troops should avoid enemy battleships. You just need to land quickly.
dictionary.这次敌军舰队的规模十分庞大，我的战舰恐怕不能支撑太长的时间。: The number of the enemy fleet is great. I'm afraid my battleship won't hold long.
dictionary.为了迷惑敌军，我会假装从正面向敌人的防线进攻。: I will pretend to attack enemy's defense line from the front to divert their attention.
